articles.title: LeBron James Takes His Time Picking His Next Team
articles.summary: Imagine being the best basketball player ever and 30 teams want you! LeBron James isn't rushing. His agent says it's a 'business choice' and he'll decide when he's ready. The 41-year-old left the Lakers three weeks ago.

articles.title: How Soccer Helps a Refugee Community Feel at Home in Pennsylvania
articles.summary: In Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, kids from Bhutanese refugee families play soccer to connect with their heritage. The game was a lifeline in refugee camps, and now a tournament named after a beloved coach raises money for youth programs.

articles.title: New UK Prime Minister Says He'll Focus on Making Life Cheaper
articles.summary: Andy Burnham just became the UK's prime minister and held his first cabinet meeting. He promised a 'cost of living government' to help people with high prices. But his plan to pay for it by canceling a digital ID project caused a big argument.
